sequences.name: Savant
abilities: Knowledge (Mysticism and Mechanics): Gain new information about mysticism and mechanics.
Recall (Memory): Can recall every single piece of knowledge and experience ever seen.

sequences.name: Archaeologist
abilities: Physical Enhancements: Strong enough physique to face many problems.
Spirituality: Barely able to apply some Ritualistic Magic.
Knowledge (History, Survival, Mysticism): Good deal of knowledge about history, wilderness survival, and taboos about ruins.

sequences.name: Appraiser
abilities: Appraisal: Can rapidly identify the powers and problems of most Beyonder items without Divination.

sequences.name: Artisan (Machinery Specialist)
abilities: Spirituality: Only the level of their Ritualistic Magic will be enhanced.
Manufacturing: Can make Beyonder items and mechanical artifacts, reshape Beyonder Characteristics, and craft Sealed Artifacts.

sequences.name: Astronomer (Astromancer)
abilities: Astronomy: Can make use of astronomical phenomena to interfere with or attack targets.
False Constellations: Can create a fake Starry Sky to confuse or interfere with astrological predictions.
Star of Curses: Can fire rays from condensed Starlight that cause weakness, mutation, and trauma.
Blessing of Stars: Can attract Starlight, altering Gravity.

sequences.name: Alchemist
sequences.description: Mechanical Heaven is not only a description of the Divine Kingdom of a Paragon but also an acknowledgment of the Alchemists' usual performance.
abilities: Alchemy: Can infuse items with Souls, giving them life.
Manufacturing: Can make mechanical bodies and modify their own bodies.
Mythical Creature Form: Incomplete Mythical Creature Form.

sequences.name: Arcane Scholar (Demon of Arcana)
abilities: Knowledge Spirit: Can transform into knowledge to influence thinking and intelligence.
Environment Controller: Can accurately extract information about the surrounding environment.
Absorption: Can extract Life force from organisms within a five-kilometer radius.
Dissociation: Can emit a beam of light capable of destroying the structures of most objects.
Manufacturing: Extraordinary Manufacturing abilities; can create giant robots.
Appraisal: Can quickly grasp relevant information when using Mystical Items.
Mythical Creature Form: Can respond to prayers.

sequences.name: Knowledge Magister (Master)
abilities: Manufacturing: Weakened authority; can create most items imagined, including futuristic wonders.
Principles: Can alter physical Principles to a certain extent.
Analysis: Enhanced Analysis authority; can see the essence of Angels.
Mentor: Ability to Test others and teach.
Learning: Weakened Learning authority; learning after one look is no longer a myth.
Mythical Creature Form: Complete Informational being composed of depictions of civilizations.

sequences.name: Illuminator (Civilization Enlightener, Light of Darkness)
abilities: Civilization: Authority over Civilization; can allow Chaos to settle into Order and reveal projections of history.
Manufacturing: Enhanced; can manifest artistic expressions with Mechanical Creations.
Education: Can enhance intelligence, provide enlightenment, or trap enemies in mathematical mazes.
Mythical Creature Form: Can manifest complete depiction of Civilization.

sequences.name: Paragon
abilities: Reality Knowledge: Possesses all discovered Knowledge; can modify it to a certain extent.
Civilization: Can designate groups to remain in barbarism or rapidly evolve; can turn others into Knowledge.
Principles: Partial authority over Principles; can make the world operate favorably.
Education: Partial authority to grant Knowledge; emphasizes enlightenment and systematization.
Learning: Can learn easily or make it impossible for others to learn.
Manufacturing: Can create advanced programs and mystical items.
Analysis: Can analyze or see the essence of things.
Spirit World Mentor: Partial authority over the Spirit World.
Divine Kingdom: Mechanical Heaven or Civilization's Cemetery, Land of Perfection.
